name: tfast-ads-manager
description: TFast Ads Manager — a senior paid-media agent for Codex CLI. Audit, optimize, and launch campaigns across Google Ads, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), TikTok, LinkedIn, Bing, GA4, Shopify, Klaviyo & Search Console. 68 model-invoked AI ads playbooks for TFast Digital Agency.

interface.shortDescription: AI-powered advertising command center for agencies — Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Bing, GA4, Shopify, Klaviyo & Search Console. 68 AI ads playbooks.
interface.longDescription:
TFast Ads Manager connects your agent to your clients' ad accounts and ships 68 expert-authored AI ads playbooks so it reasons like a senior performance marketer — not a generic chatbot.

• 68 model-invoked skills covering Google Ads (Search, Shopping, PMax), Meta (Facebook/Instagram), TikTok, GA4, Shopify, Search Console, Klaviyo, LinkedIn, Bing Ads, document generation (DOCX, PPTX, PDF, XLSX), plus agency, research, strategy, creative, optimization and attribution packs.
• Auto-loaded guardrails — recommendations follow the same constraints TFast uses internally (no synthetic data, no fabricated keywords, proper attribution discipline).
• Audit, optimize, and create — pull insights, propose budget moves, build campaigns from natural-language briefs.
• Multi-client agency platform — Client Brains, Agency Commander, budget governor, dry-run operations, and approval gates.

Built for TFast Digital Agency.
defaultPrompt: Audit my Meta Ads account for the last 30 days.
Pull a 7-day Google Ads performance report and flag campaigns to scale.
Run a TikTok creative fatigue detection pass.
Which clients need my attention today?
